name: ESP32 DevKit 30-pin (ESP32-WROOM-32)
description: 30-pin ESP32-WROOM-32 development board with USB-serial, onboard 3.3 V regulator and 5 V USB input.
notes: Dimensions approximate and NOT verified (dimensions_verified=false). Modelled as the 30-pin breakout; the 38-pin variant has a wider pinout. GPIO facts carry verify_against_datasheet=true.

rails.name: 3V3
rails.source_note: Onboard AMS1117 / LM1117 3.3 V regulator fed from the 5 V USB rail. Budget of 500 mA is approximate; the regulator thermal limit depends on the 5 V to 3.3 V drop.

rails.name: 5V
rails.source_note: USB VBUS nominally supplies 500 mA (USB 2.0). The ESP32 and 3V3 regulator draw from this. Budget approximate.

rails.name: GND
rails.source_note: Common ground. Current limit is the same return limit as the supplying rail.

board.source_note: GPIO capabilities reflect common ESP32-WROOM-32 knowledge. Verify ADC2-vs-Wi-Fi conflicts and strapping behaviour against the Espressif datasheet before relying on them.

name: DHT22 temperature and humidity sensor
description: Single-wire digital temperature (-40 to 80 C) and humidity (0 to 100 %RH) sensor.

firmware.read_snippet:
float t = dht.readTemperature();
float h = dht.readHumidity();

notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false); the bare sensor and the module differ. Needs a data wire only; VCC on 3V3.

name: Capacitive soil moisture sensor v2
description: Corrosion-resistant capacitive soil moisture probe with an analog output proportional to wetness.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false); probe is a long pronged stick, only the head needs enclosure access. Power from 3V3 so AOUT stays in the ESP32 ADC range.

name: SSD1306 0.96 inch I2C OLED (128x64)
description: Monochrome 128x64 OLED over I2C at address 0x3C.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Mount on the lid so the screen faces the user through the top opening. I2C address 0x3C fixed on this module.

name: BME280 temperature, humidity and pressure sensor
description: I2C precision temperature, humidity and pressure sensor at address 0x76.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Must run on 3V3 (max 3.6 V). Address 0x76 assumed; verify the SDO jumper.

name: BH1750 ambient light sensor
description: I2C digital ambient light sensor reporting lux at address 0x23.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). ADDR pin sets 0x23 (low) or 0x5C (high); this catalog assumes 0x23. Must run on 3V3.

name: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor
description: Ultrasonic ranging module, ~2 to 400 cm, 5 V supply. ECHO outputs 5 V logic.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Runs on 5 V; ECHO is 5 V logic, so use the voltage divider part to protect the ESP32 input pin.

name: Voltage divider 5 V to 3.3 V (two resistors)
description: Two-resistor divider (e.g. 1 kOhm + 2 kOhm) used to bring a 5 V signal down to ~3.3 V for ESP32 inputs.
notes: Dimensions are a placeholder footprint (dimensions_verified=false); this represents two discrete resistors wired as a divider, not a physical module. Pass-through part with no enclosure opening.

name: SG90 micro servo (9 g)
description: 180-degree micro servo on a 5 V rail with a 3-wire interface.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Stall current ~650 mA exceeds the USB 5 V budget; power servos from the 5 V rail with care or a separate supply. Control signal is 3.3 V tolerant on this servo.

name: Passive piezo buzzer
description: Passive piezo element that plays a tone when driven with a square wave (PWM).
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Passive buzzer needs a PWM frequency (not a plain HIGH); an active buzzer would beep on HIGH but this part is the passive type.

name: 5 mm LED
description: Single-colour 5 mm through-hole LED. Requires the 220 ohm series resistor (part resistor_220r) when driven from a 3.3 V GPIO.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Required series resistor is resistor_220r; the LED must be wired ANODE -> 220 ohm -> GPIO and CATHODE -> GND (or GPIO-driven with current limiting). Mount on the lid so light exits the top opening.

name: 220 ohm resistor (1/4 W)
description: Current-limiting series resistor used with the 5 mm LED (part led_5mm) on a 3.3 V GPIO.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false); standard axial 1/4 W body. Passive pass-through part with no enclosure opening. Pairs with led_5mm.

name: Tactile push button (6x6 mm)
description: Momentary tactile switch, normally open, used with an internal pull-up.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Active-low; needs the internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP). Mount on the lid so the cap is reachable through the top opening.

name: PIR motion sensor HC-SR501
description: Passive-infrared motion detector on a 5 V rail with a 3.3 V-compatible digital output.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false); the dome and PCB vary. 5 V supply; OUT is 3.3 V TTL on most units, verify with a meter. Has a warm-up settle time after power-on.

name: WS2812B addressable LED strip (8 LEDs)
description: Eight addressable RGB LEDs on a 5 V strip, single-wire data, up to ~480 mA at full white.

actions.name: set_all
actions.snippet:
for (int i = 0; i < strip.numPixels(); i++) { strip.setPixelColor(i, c); }
strip.show();

notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false); 8-LED strip assumed at about 10 mm pitch. Data line expects 5 V logic; at 3.3 V it often works but level-shift for reliability. Full-white current exceeds the USB budget.

name: Rotary Potentiometer (10k)
description: 10 kOhm linear rotary potentiometer for analog voltage divider input.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Connect outer pins to 3V3 and GND; wiper SIG connects to an ADC pin.

name: MPU6050 6-axis accelerometer & gyroscope
description: I2C 6-axis motion tracking sensor with 3-axis accelerometer and 3-axis gyroscope at address 0x68.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). I2C address 0x68. Module includes 3.3 V regulator and pullups.

name: 5V single-channel relay module
description: Electromechanical 5V SPDT relay module with optocoupler isolation for switching AC or DC loads.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Active-HIGH coil energization.

name: 16x2 Character LCD with I2C backpack
description: 16 character by 2 line alphanumeric LCD display with PCF8574 I2C interface at address 0x27.
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). I2C address 0x27.

name: DS18B20 1-wire digital temperature probe
description: Dallas 1-wire digital temperature sensor with 9 to 12 bit resolution (-55 to 125 C).
notes: Dimensions approximate (dimensions_verified=false). Requires external 4.7k pull-up between DATA and 3V3 rail.
